analysis:
Only CHANGELOG.md (head lines 601-1020) was supplied; no code, config or threat-model changes are visible, so I found no concrete security regression. The entries describe behavior changes that other files in this PR may implement, and the next pass should check them there.

T-041 / SEC-035 (prefix cache). Line 605 enables SSD prefix caching and paged KV by default for the exact ID `Qwen3.5-9B`. Lines 602-603 add recurrent capture and a fork-target retention rule. Lines 609-610 and 612 change proof fencing and the holder index. The canonical T-041 text already covers default-on SSD, account-scoped cacheSalt, HMAC-keyed names and the 30-minute TTL. The code needs checking for scope derivation, whether `cacheSalt` stays coordinator-authored, whether the TTL stays at or below 1800s, and whether any plaintext prompt-derived metadata reaches disk. Line 613 forwards `cache_repeated_prefix_tokens` to providers. That is aggregate demand data and should be confirmed free of cross-account identifiers.

App Attest / TB-011 (T-052..T-058). Lines 663-668 add dead-key rotation: durable, rate-limited, never revokes or denies serving, and requires full re-attestation. Lines 668 and 672-677 add provider diagnostics outside the signed transcript. These must be treated as untrusted metadata, bounded and never used for authorization. Check rotation admission locking against machine merges (T-055) and the diagnostic leakage boundary (T-058).

Other changes to inspect in code:
- Lines 644-651: public model-demand publication. Check suppression thresholds (at least 20 requests and 3 accounts) and that hidden counts cannot be recovered (T-058, T-051).
- Lines 631-633: model-cache location command. Check that ambient HF/XDG variables are ignored and that symlink traversal is not exploitable (T-012/T-016).
- Lines 636-640: live model switching without re-attestation. Routing must stay fenced until readiness is confirmed (T-053).
- Lines 733-734: durable build qualification and staged artifacts (T-054).

The changelog adds no new attack surface by itself. Source files were not available, so those pieces remain unexamined.
